name: Improved Ultimate Power Supply Terminal Cover

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a protective terminal cover for a power supply, designed as an open-sided rectangular enclosure box. It features five thin walls with a wide, open gap on one of the long edges to clear terminal blocks. The box includes a rectangular switch cutout on the front face, a circular hole on the side, and a large rectangular cutout alongside a smaller circular hole on the bottom surface. Cylindrical slide-retaining rails are integrated on the outer short sides, complete with small mounting screw holes.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric terminal cover for a 3D printer power supply in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to adjust the core enclosure dimensions (base_length, base_height, base_depth, and base_thickness) as well as the sizes of various cutouts, including a rectangular power plug cutout, a rectangular switch cutout, an LED cutout, and a circular wire grommet hole.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'base' module that constructs the enclosure walls using five combined thin 'cube' primitives, leaving an 18mm gap on the bottom rear wall. It adds two cylindrical slide-retaining rails on the outer side walls using rotated 'cylinder' shapes. A top-level 'difference' operation then subtracts several shapes from this base: a 'cube' for the rectangular switch cutout, a rotated 'cylinder' for an alternative round switch cutout, a 'cube' for the AC plug, and several 'cylinder' primitives for the LED, wire grommet, plug screw holes, and side mounting screw holes.
